title: thesis-agent-isolation-experiment deployment configuration
description: The single user-facing configuration surface for azd up. Everything else is resolved from ARM outputs.

namePrefix.description: Prefix for all created resources (ACR name is <prefix>acr — must be globally unique)

vmSize.description: Arm64 SKU for the VM arm and research host

imageVersion.description: Ubuntu image version; resolved automatically when omitted

trustedControllerIp.description: Your egress IP as /32; resolves automatically from the deployment host when omitted

existingVnetResourceId.description: Reference a compatible existing VNet instead of creating one

existingRegistryName.description: Reuse an existing ACR by name instead of creating one

retentionLock.description: NEVER set by deployment; requires explicit approval + verification (see deploy/readiness-report.mjs)

components.description: Optional components; the azd pipeline enables the required set for the three-arm study
